title: EXP-005-R2 — Clean Replay: Literal Form Caption Persistence
objective: In a fresh OpenCode worker context, create a new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch form named FX_FormPropertyLab02 using the verified basic-form recipe, change only its Form-level Caption to the literal value `Form Property Lab Replay`, save through the ordinary Designer Save operation, close the form, verify that the User Preference `Unload IDO Metadata with Forms` is not enabled, then invoke the documented Form > Definition > Unload Global Form Objects or Unload All Global Form Objects command as the required form-definition cache boundary. Reopen the exact form version identified by Form name + ScopeType=User + the same ScopeName/user ID and verify that Caption persisted while all recorded comparison properties remained unchanged. Record evidence and results only in experiments/EXP-005-R2-clean-replay-literal-form-caption-persistence.md and evidence/EXP-005-R2/.

acceptance_checks.description: Pre-mutation evidence shows that FX_FormPropertyLab02 does not already exist and records the active editing identity as ScopeType=User with the current ScopeName/user ID.
FX_FormPropertyLab02 is created through the verified classic BuildFromScratch recipe, with no additional template or unrelated FX_ artifact created.

Before mutation, evidence records the fresh Form-level Name, Caption, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, and Is Master values without treating the observed initial Caption value as a universal Mongoose default.
Evidence immediately before Save shows Caption=`Form Property Lab Replay` and shows that the recorded comparison properties were not changed.
Ordinary Designer Save completes and the Designer returns to an observable clean saved state with no pending Caption edit.

Before any form-object unload, evidence shows the User Preference `Unload IDO Metadata with Forms` is not enabled. The preference is not changed during the replay. If it is enabled, the experiment stops and is recorded as blocked before performing the unload.

After Save and close, evidence shows the documented Form > Definition > Unload Global Form Objects or Unload All Global Form Objects operation was actually invoked. This documented unload is mandatory for the replay cache boundary; a new Designer tab, worker context, browser session, or application session alone does not satisfy this check.
The post-unload reopen is proven to target exactly FX_FormPropertyLab02 with ScopeType=User and the same recorded ScopeName/user ID.

In the reopened Designer after the documented form-object unload, Caption equals `Form Property Lab Replay`, while Name, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, and Is Master match the saved comparison state; screenshots or captured responses are stored under evidence/EXP-005-R2/.

The replay completes without rediscovering or changing the semantic Caption-edit procedure, without touching blocked or out-of-scope capabilities, and with the experiment record written only to experiments/EXP-005-R2-clean-replay-literal-form-caption-persistence.md.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261001-223809-guaE. Rationale: EXP-005 established an observed successful procedure for persisting a literal Form-level Caption, but the procedure is not yet replay-verified and its final reopen did not deliberately cross the documented Mongoose form-definition cache boundary. This replay keeps the mutation identical and minimal: one new FX_ form, one literal Caption edit, ordinary Designer Save, then the documented Unload Global Form Objects or Unload All Global Form Objects command before reopening the exact User-scope form version. A fresh OpenCode worker context still provides replay independence but is not treated as a substitute for the Mongoose cache unload. Because the documented unload can also clear IDO metadata when the User Preference `Unload IDO Metadata with Forms` is enabled, the replay must preflight that preference without changing it; if enabled, the experiment blocks rather than silently expanding scope.
